reserveReview.rationale: Coinbase explicitly identifies ONED as backed 1:1 by USDC in Coinbase custody. At Base block 52095848, the five dashboard-listed USDC wallets held 11857520.082376 USDC in total, against ONED totalSupply of 11857520.01. The dashboard displayed 11857520.08 USDC and 11857520.01 ONED, refreshed at 10/2/2026 10:43 PM with timezone unspecified. This is an independently reproduced on-chain snapshot, not an independent financial attestation or proof of absence of off-chain liabilities. Dependency role adjudication on 2026-10-11T01:20:44Z: Coinbase US User Agreement Appendix 4 sections 13.1.1-13.1.3 gives CCS holders transferable ownership and all economic value and risk of the corresponding reserve asset, establishing a wrapper/serial claim on USDC. This legal role does not refresh the composition snapshot or establish custody safeguards or executable redemption capacity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact-token Coinbase USDC backing disclosure corroborated by five Base USDC balances and ONED totalSupply
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The disclosed asset composition is entirely USDC. Complete off-chain obligations, reserve encumbrance and legal allocation are not established by wallet balances.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Coinbase names itself as custodian for the entire disclosed USDC reserve. The reviewed ONED holder/platform terms and dashboard do not establish a token-specific trust, legal segregation, insolvency priority or prohibition of reserve reuse; underlying Circle reserve protections do not establish these local safeguards.
